==Stats==
:[[Energy]] +15 
:[[Cold damage]]: 11-22 (Requires 9 [[Death Magic]])
:Halves skill recharge of [[spell]]s (Chance: 20%)
:Halves casting time of [[Death Magic]] [[spell]]s (Chance: 20%)
:[[Health]] +30

==Skin==
This item uses the same [[skin]] as the [[Wailing Staff]]; however, it is colored differently.
